name: Digiter Smart Cloud Lite
author: digiterorg

sections.description:
Website: digiter.org | Full version / Shop

Smart Cloud Lite gives each WordPress account with the upload_files capability its own document desk. Upload a PDF, photograph or text file from one device and retrieve it after signing in to the same website from another. Write a plain-text note, find it by filename and edit it in your browser. A revision check prevents an old tab from overwriting newer edits.

Working with documents

  • Upload UTF-8 TXT, PDF, PNG and JPEG documents. Your site’s allowed upload types also apply.
  • Create, edit, rename and download notes as ordinary TXT files.
  • Search your own filenames, browse paginated results and download individual originals.
  • Move files to Trash, restore them or explicitly confirm permanent deletion.
  • Place the shortcode [digiter_smart_cloud_lite] on a page to link to the authenticated workspace.

The workspace uses your WordPress sign-in. Its storage is a dedicated table in the site’s MySQL or MariaDB database. File contents are served only as authenticated download attachments, never saved to the public Media Library. The plugin does not browse server directories or execute uploaded files. Content checks identify supported formats and are not malware scanning.

Storage and privacy

The file limit defaults to 1 MiB per document. A site developer can change the maximum bytes using the dgcloud_lite_max_file_bytes filter. The effective limit also respects WordPress’s upload limit, the database packet capacity and the MEDIUMBLOB column size. This is a local host resource setting. There is no account, license or paid quota required for any Lite feature.

The database stores the account ID, filename, file bytes, size, modification time, revision and Trash status. The workspace enforces access per owner. File bytes are not encrypted by the plugin. People with database or backup access can read them. Include this table in your site’s protected backups. There are no public file URLs, analytics, external storage services or background network requests.

Trash is retained until its owner permanently deletes a file. Deactivation preserves data. Removing a WordPress user deletes their files, including Trash. Uninstall removes the plugin table and all accounts’ workspace files. Download files you need to keep first. The Lite workspace supports single-site WordPress.

Optional Full version

For Digiter’s separate browser desktop, Cloud Viewer, Cloud Writer and mail integration, visit the Digiter Smart Cloud shop and the Full product documentation. You can also open the shop from Smart Cloud Lite or the WordPress Plugins list. Review the product and terms on digiter.org, complete checkout and obtain the Full ZIP and license from your order or Customer Account. Download the Lite documents you want to move. Install Full under Plugins > Add Plugin > Upload Plugin, activate it, enter the license and upload your documents to the Full workspace. The two products use separate storage.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Digiter Smart Cloud Lite on a single-site WordPress installation.
  2. Sign in with an account that can upload files, then open Smart Cloud Lite in the WordPress menu.
  3. Upload a supported document or create a text note. Use Download, Edit text, Rename and Move to Trash from its row.
  4. Optionally add [digiter_smart_cloud_lite] to a page as a sign-in entry point to the private workspace.
sections.faq:
Who can open my files?

The workspace lists and downloads only the signed-in user’s documents. On default WordPress roles, administrators, editors and authors can each use their own workspace. Subscribers have no upload permission. Site operators with direct database or backup access can read stored data.

What happens if I save the same note in two tabs?

A successful save advances the document revision. An older form receives a conflict. Copy any unsaved text you wish to keep, reopen the document and apply your changes to the current version.

Can I recover a deleted document?

Open Trash and select Restore. Permanent deletion from Trash and uninstall require a backup for recovery.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Count file-name limits in Unicode characters rather than bytes.
  • Reject malformed UTF-8 file names while preserving valid multilingual names.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with owner-scoped document storage, authenticated downloads, plain-text notes, search, revision checks and recoverable Trash.
